highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.152.2 improves Ganesh flush and GPU-buffer upload failure handling.

bullets.detail: Tracks task execution separately from success and propagates upload failures so affected draws are dropped instead of using stale buffers. Existing managed flush operations remain void.
Windows HarfBuzz native assets no longer trigger BinSkim BA2007 for disabled compiler warnings. Exported symbols and shaping behavior are unchanged.
